excerpt: Trade Republic is a Berlin-based licensed bank and broker app for investing, saving and card spending across Europe. Valued at €12.5B in a December 2025 secondary share sale.
content:
Trade Republic is a European investing and banking app from Berlin. Its tagline is "Invest, spend and bank": customers invest in listed assets, hold cash that earns interest and spend with a Trade Republic card. The homepage advertises investing from €1, interest on cash (2.5% a year when we checked) and a card with no subscription fee that earns 1% "Saveback". The company operates as Trade Republic Bank GmbH, headquartered at Brunnenstraße in Berlin.

Its fee details are published in the app and in a pricing overview on its website, which opens from the homepage.

In December 2025 Trade Republic confirmed a secondary share sale of about €1.2 billion that valued it at €12.5 billion, according to Tech.eu and FinTech Futures. Existing investors including Founders Fund, Sequoia, Accel, TCV and Thrive Capital bought shares, and new investors including Wellington, Fidelity, Khosla Ventures and GIC joined. The deal raised no new money for the company; it gave early shareholders a way to sell. FinTech Futures reported that Trade Republic was last valued at about €5 billion after a €250 million Series C extension led by Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan in June 2022, and that the company says it has been profitable for three years and has more than 10 million customers with around €150 billion in assets.

Investing involves risk: the value of investments can fall as well as rise, and interest rates on cash change. This profile is not investment advice. It draws on Trade Republic's own site and published reporting. We have not tested the app, and nothing here is paid placement.
